## Round 2 — Build on received ideas (5 minutes)

Each participant receives the previous participant's sheet (round-robin) and adds ideas that extend, combine, or contrast with the existing entries.

| Sheet from → reviewed by | New idea 1 | New idea 2 | New idea 3 |
|---|---|---|---|
| P1 → P2 | _[Idea]_ | _[Idea]_ | _[Idea]_ |
| P2 → P3 | _[Idea]_ | _[Idea]_ | _[Idea]_ |
| P3 → P4 | _[Idea]_ | _[Idea]_ | _[Idea]_ |
| P4 → P1 | _[Idea]_ | _[Idea]_ | _[Idea]_ |

---

## Round 3 — Refinement (5 minutes)

Each participant reviews the full sheet now in hand and adds refinements: sharpen an idea, merge two ideas, or propose a first implementation step for the most promising entry.

|---|---|---|---|
